decisions.message: Thank you for your patience in recent weeks. For the next 8 weeks, if you dispute a card charge we credit up to $100 right away. We are adding a $10 credit to your account to thank you for your patience. Paychecks paid into Cobalt can now show up to 2 days early.

actions.action: Free instant transfers to other banks
Early pay up to 2 days early, permanently

decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. Instant transfers to other banks are free for the next 2 weeks. Paychecks paid into Cobalt can now show up to 2 days early, so Friday Dec 11 pay may arrive by Wed Dec 9. We have added 150 support staff for the coming weeks.

Cost $1,300,000 of the $4M budget.
